main.description: Cancel an unpublished clip draft: deletes the ephemeral muxed file immediately instead of waiting for the 10-minute TTL sweep, and removes the draft row. Fails if the draft was already published.

clipId.description: The clip ID returned by place.stream.clip.create.

cancelled.description: True when the draft's ephemeral file was deleted.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.description: The request lacks valid authentication credentials.

errors.name: DraftNotFound
errors.description: No unpublished draft with the given ID belongs to the authenticated user.

errors.name: AlreadyPublished
errors.description: The draft has already been published and cannot be cancelled.
